color.why: Both restore the exact warm neutrals, screen-white primary and restrained brass. Calculated dim/panel is 7.08:1, faint/panel 5.34:1 and brass/panel 7.64:1. Y improves the input boundary to faint/wall 5.65:1; X uses seam/wall 1.40:1 (X:179-186, Y:510-524). Neither supplied axe report contains a text contrast failure.

typography.why: Both use a coherent Geist display/body hierarchy with correct weight, tracking and line height. Y consistently sets counts and durations in mono and wraps file paths deliberately (Y:759-768,873-878); X leaves room counts/durations in sans (X:309-312,379). X also crowds the mobile ask placeholder, while Y stacks the form.

layout.why: Both eliminate the measured 996px mobile overflow. Y retains a compact, scannable four-file list, exposes current-room navigation, and stacks the ask input/button at 390px (Y:509-511,677-703; ready-390-full.png). X gives the latest render a dominant frame but puts older files below the desktop fold and squeezes its mobile input beside Send ask (X:178-180,403-409; ready-1440-full.png).

accessibility.why: Both provide native room links, labelled inputs, landmarks, visible brass focus and error alerts. X hides the only Jump to and Tablet names with display:none on mobile (X:288-289,246-249), lacks a loading live region (443-454), and has a low-contrast input boundary. Y preserves the hidden Jump to text, labels Tablet, supplies a skip link, exposes individual stages, uses a native modal and announces loading (Y:697,707,812,820-835,940). Both supplied axe reports still flag a missing loading h1; the region finding lacks node detail and may concern excluded Bench scaffolding.

states.why: Both replace the empty/error dead ends and add confirmation before deletion. X retry returns from loading to the error after 900ms, offers a Board recovery route and has a detailed skeleton/fade (X:457-474,517-520). Y has the better native modal and form validation, but retry only sets loading and never settles (Y:1008), its modal falsely states 4 renders in the empty state (724), and its loading skeleton omits the separate ask panel (936-939).

copy.why: Both replace pipeline/Submit jargon with agent asks, explain optional rooms/chat, and give human missing-file messages. X correctly limits the error to the board and explains that Desk records do not break the piece (X:460-463); Y more clearly says the next agent you run picks up the ask (Y:855). Both falsely claim successful saving/deletion without persistence; Y additionally claims Finder opened (Y:1006), overstates a board-file failure as the whole piece failing (948), and miscounts deletion contents in empty state (724).

motion.why: Both remove transition:all, 1.1 hover scaling and long staggered entrances. X provides a 220ms opacity arrival, 450ms projector image lighting and explicitly stops shimmer under reduced motion (X:148,234-260). Its loading view still has 15 indefinite sweeps, excessive for a quiet studio (metrics line 3). Y keeps motion mainly on opacity/transform but its 1s infinite spinner is outside its no-preference guard and has no reduce override (Y:575-583,654-675); its ready-state reduced-motion metrics do not test that spinner. Y also swaps whole views without a continuity transition (976-980).

ux.why: Both restore the quiet screening-room identity and route render intent to an agent rather than running a model. X makes the work visually lead and offers an explicit Ask for a render primary, though it over-prioritizes rendering in an empty optional workspace. Y is a restrained refinement of the original overview, with current-room navigation including the documented Cast room, and a general Send ask primary; tiny thumbnails reduce the work-led character. Y recovery deadlock and X mobile control names remain material ship fixes.

X: Mobile Jump to and Tablet become unnamed icon-only controls: display:none removes all their name text and neither button has aria-label (X/index.html:246-249,288-289).

Ask field boundary is seam/wall, calculated 1.40:1, insufficient to distinguish the empty input; mobile form keeps a narrow inline field instead of stacking (X/index.html:178-186; X/shots/ready-390-full.png).

Ask submission clears user input and says Saved without writing or retaining it; deletion similarly claims removal from the workspace with only innerHTML changes (X/index.html:505-506,527-540). Static-demo limitation, but success copy is misleading.
Fifteen perpetual skeleton sweeps add unnecessary loading motion (X/index.html:198; X/shots/metrics.jsonl:3). Loading has busy text but no live announcement (443-454).
Retry timer is not cancelled by Bench switching: selecting ready during the 900ms retry can be overwritten back to error, leaving URL/Bench choice out of sync (X/index.html:517-520,554-556).
Y: Try again enters loading forever: the click handler invokes setState("loading") with no completion or failure path (Y/index.html:1008,923-940).
Loading spinner runs under prefers-reduced-motion: animation is unconditional at Y/index.html:581 and no reduce override exists; the no-preference block at 654-675 only gates other effects.
Empty-state deletion dialog still says the piece has 4 renders although the empty screen says there is nothing in it (Y/index.html:724,907-920).

Finder says Opened without invoking Finder, ask submission discards input and claims saved without persistence, and deletion only changes the view (Y/index.html:1006,1029-1032,1043-1046). Static-demo limitation, but the success claims are false.
Removed the existing Settings band control visible in before-shots/ready-1440.png; Y/index.html:805-813 supplies only Jump to and Tablet without an alternate settings affordance.
Rendering replaces the focused Retry button with no focus handoff, and full state swaps have no arrival continuity (Y/index.html:976-980,1008).

overall.why: I would ship X because its work-led presentation, board-specific recovery and effective reduced-motion handling better preserve the Desk’s screening-room identity across all four states. Y has stronger mobile forms, navigation semantics and a native confirmation dialog, but its retry never settles and its loading spinner ignores reduced motion. X still needs mobile control names, a clearer input boundary, truthful static-demo feedback and fewer loading animations before an unqualified release.
